title: POV: You Wake Up in Derinkuyu — The Underground City of Cappadocia #shorts
hook_text: AN ENTIRE COMMUNITY COULD DISAPPEAR UNDERGROUND
description:
Step into Derinkuyu, reconstructed as a cinematic historical short using archaeological evidence and cautious interpretation. Some details remain debated or uncertain.

#history #archaeology #lostworlds #ancienthistory #shorts
